config.expected_if_false: At least 2 of 3 seeds have a persistent formation step outside [70, 100], or accel_step never stays above required_margin. Either outcome means the N=64 reference itself is unstable, and the N=64 vs N=256 comparison has to account for that larger seed spread.
config.expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds, accel_step's persistent formation step (the first checkpoint after which margin >= required_margin at every later checkpoint) falls in [70, 100]. Final accel_step R2 at the best layer is 0.88-0.91 against control 0.72-0.79. val_mse_ratio first falls below 1 between steps 130 and 170, after accel_step forms.
config.hypothesis: Matched-seed reference arm (N=64) for testing whether accel_step formation timing depends on steps_per_orbit. With seeds 56-58, best-of-5 controls and 10-step checkpoints, accel_step at N=64 first reaches its required margin, and stays above it at every later checkpoint, within steps 70-100. That reproduces f-20261012-005950-42a7 (raw formation 80-90) on fresh seeds, at the same checkpoint spacing as the paired N=256 arm.
